reason: The v0 success rule treated seven test clusters as equally informative for every task, although rare positive labels may occur in only a subset, and T1/T2 have no source model. This amendment separates scientific questions without changing or opening outcomes.

must_complete: retry and resolve the six transient materialization errors
freeze the final eligible-cube manifest and exclusion-reason hashes
complete exclusion selection-bias audit by date, cluster, task availability, cloud and platform
freeze 128-pixel chip grid and cache manifest
verify and document that no Korea performance label was used to select cubes, chips, thresholds, recipes or this amendment
readiness_gate.known_file_audit: 2,536 materialized and 163 excluded (6.0%); materialized shape/dtype/common-coverage failures 0; this is file integrity, not experiment eligibility

questions.Q1_shared_asset: Can one physical OlmoEarth cache support three task heads without re-reading raw cubes or re-running the encoder?
questions.Q2_label_efficiency: At K=5 and K=20, does a cache head outperform a raw model trained with the same target labels and selection exposure?
questions.Q3_transfer: For landslides only, does the Sen12 source head transfer to spatially held-out Korea before and after K-shot adaptation?
questions.Q4_amortization: At what number of task heads does measured shared-cache cost become lower than separate raw pipelines?
questions.Q5_policy_stress: Under the same pixels and input contract, do task and support composition change the preferred cache action?

T1_land_cover_and_T2_deforestation: CACHE_K: frozen cache plus task head trained on K labels
RAW_K: raw model trained from scratch on the identical K labels
T3_landslide: CACHE_K head adaptation and RAW_K adaptation on identical support

support.rule: Random is the deployment-primary draw. Positive-aware is a labeled-support sensitivity, not a replacement. Record positive count for each task, cluster, draw and seed.

statistics.outer_unit: task (n=3); test clusters are nested deployment groups, not three additional datasets
statistics.cluster_reporting: report every cluster, but do not require a positive-class IoU win in a cluster with no positive query pixels

task_metrics.land_cover: cluster-macro class mIoU plus per-class AP
task_metrics.deforestation: all-cluster AP and FP-matched IoU; positive-query-cluster IoU as a separate conditional metric
task_metrics.landslide: all-cluster AP and FP-matched IoU; positive-query-cluster IoU as a separate conditional metric

statistics.success: directionally favorable CACHE_K versus RAW_K in at least two of three tasks at both K values, with task effect sizes and a task-level interval reported; no impossible fixed 5/7 positive-cluster rule
statistics.no_independence_claim: The three tasks share cubes and splits; correlated gains are evidence of shared-asset utility, not three independent replications.

measure_once: OlmoEarth cache materialization GPU seconds and bytes
cost_contract.report: wall/GPU time and bytes for N=1,2,3 tasks; measured break-even only, with no rounded cost estimates

selector_role.allowed: external shared-cache stress case for the S_support submatrix in geobench_cache_action_prereg_v1.json
selector_role.not_allowed: counting Korea's three correlated tasks as sufficient held-out validation of a general selector
selector_role.value: same pixels, same cache and same region split isolate task/support effects better than cross-dataset comparisons

label_seal: This amendment changes design only. It authorizes no label-content inspection and no performance run until readiness_gate passes and the amendment is committed.
